# Anoop Sinkaran
Blacktown NSW, Australia • 0406 295 160 • ns.anoop@gmail.com • linkedin.com/in/anoop-sinkaran

## Professional Summary
Accomplished automation and quality engineer with extensive experience developing scalable test automation suites, system integration validations, and data integrity solutions across enterprise platforms. Proficient in programming and scripting with C#, Python, .NET, SQL, and modern JavaScript/TypeScript, with proven success driving platform migrations and managing cloud integrations. Adept at leveraging Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines, Git workflows, and API testing to streamline deployments and enhance organizational software performance.
